app.title: Lightning Café
app.subtitle: Sandbox Lightning
app.disclaimer: Simulated sats only — not real Bitcoin.

nav.priceTip: Fixed sandbox price: $100,000 per BTC, so $100 = 100,000 sats. The real price moves all the time.

session.tip: Learn with a friend on the same chain
session.invite: You can learn with a friend by sending them a link.

assets.createdBlurb: These 12 words are the key to your wallet. Keep them offline so you can recover it.
assets.createdTip: The wallet draws a secret at random (a private key). The 12 words are just a way to write it down, so you can get it back later. This is not a real BIP39 seed: here the words are cat names.
assets.utxoHint: A UTXO is a chunk of sats already received, not yet spent. The wallet balance is the sum of those chunks.
assets.restoreSubtitle: The 12 words recover the keys. Sats already on those addresses (even after F5 in a Café session) come back with them.
assets.restoreHint: One word per box. Paste all 12 (even with 1. or 1-) to fill the grid.
assets.restoreCreated: Wallet restored. Sats on those addresses are back.
assets.deleteConfirm: Remove this wallet from the screen? The 12 words bring it back, with sats already on the chain.
assets.seedWarning: These 12 words give access to every sat in this wallet. Nobody should ever ask for them: not a support agent, not a website, not a friend.
assets.publicTip: Sandbox public address (lc1q), derived from your 12 words. Safe to share. This is not a real Bitcoin address.
assets.secretTip: The 12 words write down the private key. Never share them. This is not a real BIP39 seed — they are cat names.

services.title: Services
services.buyTip: Exchange $ for sats via an exchange
services.pasteFailed: The clipboard is empty or blocked by the browser
services.addressWarning: If this address is wrong, you will no longer have access to the funds.
services.speedHint: You bid a sat/vB. Above the market you get in, below you wait, around it (±20%) is a coin flip. Your rate does not change; the market does.
services.feePreview: Miner fee for a typical 140 vB transaction.

feePayer.exchange: The exchange pays it; you pay the $ for the sats.
feePayer.you: Taken from this wallet, on top of the amount you send.

services.exchangeSpreadTip: Cut the exchange keeps on the conversion. It pays the miner fee.
services.sellConfirmationsTip: The exchange only credits your $ after {{count}} confirmations. The first block can still be reorganized; waiting {{count}} blocks is the usual practice for a Bitcoin deposit. No extra cut from the exchange — you only pay the miner fee you pick when you send.
services.sellTip: Exchange sats for $ via an exchange

layers.lightningPlaceholder: Lightning network graph will appear here.
layers.nextBlockTip: Sandbox estimate (~1 min). On real Bitcoin a block takes ~10 minutes on average — it is not a fixed interval.
layers.feeTip: sat/vB is a fee rate, not an amount. Higher means those transactions paid more to get into the block.
layers.upcomingBlockTip: {{priority}}. A reading of the market now, not a wagon that moves up. {{txs}} projected txs.
layers.confirmedBlockTip: Block #{{height}} mined by {{pool}}. {{fee}} sat/vB · {{txs}} confirmed transactions.
layers.inspectEmpty: None of your addresses with sats are here.

footer.resetConfirm: Clear wallets, sats, and the chain saved in this browser? (Clearing the browser cache is not enough — this lives in local storage.)
